title: HR & Systems Coordinator
description:
HR & Systems Coordinator - 12 month FTC

The HR & Systems Coordinator provides high-quality HR administration across the employee lifecycle while acting as the HR team s subject-matter expert and super user for Sage People. The role combines day-to-day HR operational support with responsibility for HR data, systems support, benefits administration, payroll inputs, reporting and continuous improvement.

Role Mission
To provide an accurate, responsive and employee-focused HR administration service, while using extensive knowledge of Sage People and associated HR processes to support colleagues, resolve queries, maintain data integrity and improve how HR systems and processes are used across the business.

Objectives & Key Results
The HR & Systems Coordinator is part of the HR & People team and supports managers, employees and HR colleagues throughout the employee lifecycle.

The key objectives will be to:
- Ensure employee data in Sage People and associated HR records is accurate, complete and maintained on time
- Provide responsive first-line support for HR administration, Sage People and employee benefits queries
- Complete employee lifecycle administration accurately and within agreed deadlines
- Provide accurate HR and benefits inputs into the monthly UK payroll process
- Produce reliable HR reports and management information to support decision-making
- Coordinate UK benefits administration and maintain positive working relationships with providers
- Maintain clear, up-to-date process guidance and system resources for employees, managers and HR colleagues
- Identify and support practical improvements to HR systems, workflows and administrative processes
- Explore and support appropriate opportunities to use automation and AI to improve efficiency, accuracy and the employee experience

Behavioural Competencies Organisational & Behavioural Fit
- Highly organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver accurately to deadlines
- Proactive and accountable, taking ownership of queries and actions through to completion
- Approachable and service-focused, with a practical and professional communication style
- Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential and sensitive employee information
- Curious and improvement-focused, with the confidence to question inefficient processes and suggest practical changes
- Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively across teams and respond to changing priorities
- Calm under pressure and able to apply sound judgement about when to resolve, refer or escalate an issue.
- Critical Competencies Technical Fit
- Practical experience of HR administration across the employee lifecycle within a busy HR or People team
- Strong experience of using and administering an HR information system, with the ability to develop detailed system knowledge and support other users
- Experience maintaining employee records and completing data-quality checks with a high level of accuracy
- Confident Excel skills, including filters, lookups, pivot tables and data validation
- Experience producing regular and ad hoc HR reports and presenting data clearly
- Experience supporting payroll inputs, benefits administration or related reconciliations
- Ability to troubleshoot routine HR system and data issues and escalate appropriately
- Good understanding of confidentiality, UK GDPR and the handling of sensitive employee data
- Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear guidance and employee communications
- Experience of Sage People and/or Sage Recruit is desirable
- Experience supporting system testing, workflows, forms or process automation is desirable
- An interest in, or practical experience of, using automation and AI tools to improve HR administration, reporting or colleague support is desirable
- CIPD Level 3, or equivalent practical HR experience, is desirable

title: HR Administrator
company: G-TEKT Europe Manufacturing Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
The HR Administrator will play a key part in ensuring a smooth and professional HR function, supporting both day-to-day operational requirements and longer-term people initiatives.

This role will support our two plants onsite in our head office in Brockworth Gloucester. This role would suit someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced HR department, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

Role Responsibilities
- Providing administration support across the full employee life cycle. Completing administration for new starters, leavers, inductions and off boarding.
- Respond to daily queries from employees and managers in person and through HR email inbox
- Recruitment and screening for production roles including ensuring compliance with right to work checks
- Absence monitoring includes management of everyday sickness absence notifications and relevant documentation.
- Provide timely information to payroll, maintaining data accuracy and compliance across systems and shared inbox
- Identifying and implementing system and process improvements and contribute to weekly meetings.
- Supporting Assistant Manager with compliance and ad hoc HR projects including community engagement activities
- Arranging occupational health for new starters
- Updating and maintaining HR system

Qualifications and experience
- Experience as an administrator working within the manufacturing industry (desirable)
- Level 3 CIPD (desirable)
- Basic awareness of employment law
- Must have strong communication, interpersonal skills and time management
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Possess a high level of integrity and confidentiality
- Resilient under pressure
- Hours 37.5 hours per week (Onsite) Mon-Fri
- Paid overtime as agreed by manager
- 25 days holiday
- Potential for Advancement
